# PostureCheckMFA

PostureCheckMFA is a Ziti posture check that an identity passes while it is authenticated with a second factor.

| | |
|---|---|
| API version | `ziti.crossplane.io/v1alpha1` |
| Scope | Namespaced |
| In Ziti | posture check of type `MFA`, `/edge/management/v1/posture-checks` |
| Updated with | `PATCH`: a setting that is left out of the spec is left alone in Ziti |

## Example

From [`examples/posturecheck/mfa.yaml`](../../examples/posturecheck/mfa.yaml):

```yaml
apiVersion: ziti.crossplane.io/v1alpha1
kind: PostureCheckMFA
metadata:
  name: mfa
spec:
  providerConfigRef:
    kind: ProviderConfig
    name: default
  forProvider:
    name: mfa
    timeoutSeconds: 3600
    promptOnWake: true
    promptOnUnlock: true
    roleAttributes:
      - mfa
```

## Settings: `spec.forProvider`

| Field | Type | Default | Field in Ziti | What it does in Ziti |
|-------|------|---------|---------------|----------------------|
| `name` | string, required |  | `name` | Name of the posture check. |
| `ignoreLegacyEndpoints` | boolean |  | `ignoreLegacyEndpoints` | IgnoreLegacyEndpoints does not apply the timeout and prompts to endpoints that do not support them. |
| `promptOnUnlock` | boolean |  | `promptOnUnlock` | PromptOnUnlock asks for MFA again when the device is unlocked. |
| `promptOnWake` | boolean |  | `promptOnWake` | PromptOnWake asks for MFA again when the device wakes up. |
| `roleAttributes` | list of strings |  | `roleAttributes` | RoleAttributes are the attributes service policies select the posture check by, as "#attribute". |
| `tags` | map of strings |  | `tags` | Tags is a map of tags. |
| `timeoutSeconds` | integer | `-1` | `timeoutSeconds` | TimeoutSeconds for the MFA check. -1 means no timeout. |

The provider also sends `typeId: MFA`.

The settings every managed resource has, such as `spec.providerConfigRef`,
`spec.managementPolicies` and `spec.writeConnectionSecretToRef`, are described
in [Concepts](../concepts.md).

## How it behaves

- The identity passes while it has authenticated with TOTP. `timeoutSeconds` asks for it again after that long, `promptOnWake` and `promptOnUnlock` when the device wakes up or is unlocked.
- A posture check does nothing on its own: name it in `postureCheckRoles` of a [`ServicePolicy`](servicepolicy.md), as `@name` or by a role attribute.

## When something goes wrong

- Clients that do not support the timeout and the prompts fail the check: set `ignoreLegacyEndpoints`.

Create, update, drift, deletion in Ziti and deletion of the resource are covered by the end-to-end test, see [Testing](../testing.md).
